name: videofunker
description: Video Funker — AI-generated video content that books meetings. Monorepo: marketing client + product app, BFF server, product API.

scripts.build: npm --workspace api run build && npm --workspace client run build

//overrides: react-day-picker 8 declares a React peer range that stops at 18. The client
is pinned to React 19 because Next 15's App Router requires it, so without
this the install fails outright with ERESOLVE — and the usual workaround,
--legacy-peer-deps, disables peer checking for EVERY package in the tree,
including the ones where a real mismatch would matter. This narrows the
exception to the one package that needs it.
It stays on 8 deliberately: 9 and 10 replaced the components API that
and IconRight became Chevron). The range is stale metadata, not a
functional limit — the library works on 19.
The two other packages that had the same problem needed no override:
next-themes and vaul both publish React-19-compatible majors that are API
compatible with the shadcn wrappers, so client/package.json simply asks for
Versions are written out rather than using the $name form: $react resolves
against a direct dependency of the ROOT package, and the root of this
monorepo has no React of its own. Keep them in step with client/package.json.
